surface: Signed-in non-admin Chat native acceptance diagnostic
title: Chat acceptance organization probe misreads object-valued device selection
reproduction: Run the exact 0.2.205 signed-in non-admin Chat acceptance. A real answer and canonical extension admin check HTTP 200 with zero rows pass.
The receipt reports activeOrganizationPresent:false even though the runner observes a selected organization in the UI.
The harness storedSessionShape predicate expects the matrx.org.active storage value to be a string; the current production value is an object with id and name.
expected: The native acceptance probe recognizes the production device organization shape and reports an exact organization readback, so a false shape mismatch cannot be mistaken for a product failure or a verified persistence pass.
actual: The string-only probe reports false on the object-valued key. Signed-in non-admin Chat answered, but exact organization storage readback and persistence remain unverified. No product organization defect is established.
severity: S3: acceptance evidence is ambiguous; no product failure established
priority: P1: repair the probe before relying on member organization acceptance
